My first research rotation as a Ph.D. student involved recoding qualitative data from the 2025 Cleveland Health Survey. This was an iterative process during which I developed a new codebook that can be used for future Cleveland Health Surveys or to conduct preliminary exploratory analysis of the 2025 data. This was a ten-week process that gave me a deeper understanding of the issues that Cleveland residents face in their communities, as described in their own words. 

## Sound of Ideas

Public health segments produced or co-produced by me for the [Sound of Ideas](https://www.ideastream.org/podcast/sound-of-ideas), the morning public affairs show on [Ideastream Public Media](https://www.ideastream.org/), Cleveland's NPR station. For more segments, click [here](https://www.ideastream.org/people/asha-agarwal).

- *Northeast Ohio experts discuss homelessness and federal efforts to deter crime and drug use* [(listen)](https://www.ideastream.org/show/sound-of-ideas/2025-08-07/northeast-ohio-experts-discuss-homelessness-and-federal-efforts-to-deter-crime-and-drug-use)
- *Free clinics brace for larger role with Medicaid cuts looming* [(listen)](https://www.ideastream.org/show/sound-of-ideas/2025-07-22/free-clinics-brace-for-larger-role-with-medicaid-cuts-looming)
- *Major changes to Medicaid could impact access to coverage for Ohioans* [(listen)](https://www.ideastream.org/show/sound-of-ideas/2025-07-15/major-changes-to-medicaid-could-impact-access-to-coverage-for-ohioans)
- *Where does the opioid overdose epidemic stand in Cuyahoga County and Cleveland?* [(listen)](https://www.ideastream.org/show/sound-of-ideas/2025-07-09/where-does-the-opioid-overdose-epidemic-stand-in-cuyahoga-county-and-cleveland)

## Role of the Rfa2 winged-helix domain

During a semester as a student and researcher with Dr. Alex Pike at Oberlin College, I performed molecular biology experiments to mutate the winged-helix domain of the Rfa2 protein in S. cerevisiae and test cellular response to DNA damage from UV light. Results were used to support hypothesis testing surrounding the role that the winged-helix domain plays in DNA damage response, an important pathway to understand for cancer research. 

## QSAR model predicting ligand compatibility with prostate-specific membrane antigen

As a computational biology research assistant to Dr. Zahra Nikfarjam, I used software like LeDock and AutoDock to simulate the binding of various ligands to the prostate-specific membrane antigen (PSMA). Ligands were synthesized using prior literature on PSMA ligand structures and pharmacokinetic properties, then altering the ligand composition to maximize fit. The results of docking simulations were used to refine a quantitative structure-activity relationship (QSAR) model.
